rationale: Increasing diversity_rarefaction_depth from 500 to 600 changes the minimum sampling depth supplied to QIIME2_DIVERSITY_CORE, which uses the maximum of this parameter and the smallest sample read count, excluding samples below the resulting depth. Its regenerated diversity vectors, distance matrices, ordination artefacts and rarefaction information affect the downstream diversity analyses and SUMMARY_REPORT, while MULTIQC is affected by the updated parameter summary. No process activation conditions change, and QIIME2_ALPHARAREFACTION and QIIME2_TREE do not depend on this parameter; feasibility assumes sufficient samples remain for the downstream statistical analyses, which cannot be verified from the source code alone.
